async def run(items):
    for index in range(len(items)-1, -1, -1):
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await asyncio.gather(save(items[index]), notify(items[index]))
    for index in range(len(items), 0, -4):
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await asyncio.gather(*(save(item) for item in items[index-4:index]))
